person_note: Win is the participating first-person narrator. Numerous input passages independently expose his narratorial I/my voice, including narration beats embedded in dialogue-heavy quotations. The author-hosted opening sustains the same voice, while multiple whole-book descriptions explicitly say the novel is narrated in first person by Win; no credible source indicates alternating base sections. The Kathleen quotation is local character speech with lost boundaries, not a second controlling narrator. The only limitation is that the authorized prose source covers the opening, but the book-wide structural sources and interior Goodreads passages resolve that scope limitation.
